description: When report, stitcher, or organ-contract code changes, verify the evidence discipline: every verdict/reason/note code used anywhere exists in the plain-language dictionary, every packet-producing code path sets all provenance fields, and no report component renders a number that does not come from a packet or the worklist.
name: Evidence format lint

then.prompt: Evidence-related Boltseam code was just edited. Lint the change for evidence discipline: (1) every verdict, reason, and note code referenced in the edited files exists as a key in the plain-language dictionary in src/report/ — flag codes with no reader-facing wording; (2) every code path that builds an Evidence Packet sets subClaimId, verdict, claimedValue, observedValue (or an unverifiable/source_error reason), unit, tolerance, and full provenance (source, requestUrl, fetchedAt, rawExcerpt, rawSha256 — or the Abacus local-recomputation exception with rawSha256 null and the reason stated); (3) no report or stitcher code renders a numeric value that is not traceable to a packet field or the worklist; (4) no language-model call decides a verdict. Report violations with file and line references. Do not edit files yourself; report only.
